rec.name: PDP Bulk Discount Tiers (Tabbed)
rec.status: Built — launched (code delivered with install instructions; documentation reviewed)

what.text: A custom Shopify section, 'PDP | Bulk Discounts', shown on the product page. It displays volume-discount tiers as a row of cards, e.g. '50+ desks – For large companies – 20% discount'. Product-type tabs (Desks / Chairs / Frames) sit above the cards. One card can carry a green 'Best value' badge and each card has an icon. Below the cards is a footer CTA box with a headline, a bullet list of reassurances (free shipping, 30-day money-back guarantee, customer service, extended warranty) and a button with an optional arrow icon. The section is meant for every product, not one product only.

why.text: Tiered volume discounts show buyers that ordering more lowers the unit price, which raises quantity and AOV, especially for B2B or office buyers. The 'Best value' badge anchors attention on the top tier. Each tier is tied to a customer segment ('for start-ups', 'for large companies'), so buyers can self-identify. Reassurance bullets next to the CTA reduce risk at the moment of decision. Tabs let one block cover several product categories without clutter.

how.text: Create the section file ed-pdp-bulk-discounts.liquid and paste in the supplied code (the ticket attachment includes install steps). Content is managed in the theme customizer through blocks: one 'Tab-item' block per product type or discount tier and a 'Footer' block for the CTA area. Colours and sizes are driven by CSS variables set from section settings, with theme-level fallbacks when a colour is left transparent. The active tab is black with white text and inactive tabs are muted. The tab switcher is JS-driven, with a sliding active indicator. The cards form a responsive row of 2–5 on desktop and stack on mobile. Tabs scroll horizontally or wrap on mobile. The footer button is a pill with an arrow icon that animates on hover. The section can be previewed before it is added to the theme customizer. Because it applies to every product, it is added to the default product template.

items: Section colours: text colour and background colour (transparent falls back to theme settings)
Custom max-width toggle plus max-width value
Top, bottom, left and right spacing (desktop and mobile variants)
Tab buttons: text, background, border colour, hover text and background, active text and background
Product-type tabs: selectable tab names (e.g. Desks, Chairs, Frames)
Discount cards: quantity label, description text, discount text, optional 'Best value' badge, selectable icon per card, 2–5 cards
Card styling: text, border and background colours, active/best-value card colours, corner radius, icon size
Badge: text colour, background colour, corner radius, size
Typography sizes (desktop and mobile): card heading, content, discount, footer title and footer content
Footer CTA: headline with bold/italic/underline rich text, flexible bullet list, button text, button URL, optional arrow icon
Footer styling: text colour, background colour, corner radius, button text colour, button background and hover background

dependencies.text: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with section and block support. The section file ed-pdp-bulk-discounts.liquid is added to the theme. The code references theme-level settings (settings.text_color, settings.background) and the theme's 'heading' class. The tab JS markup uses skb-* classes, and Swiper CSS appears in the code but navigation arrows are not visibly used. No product metafields are used, so content is the same on every product. The ticket asked for a product image in the documentation.
